comments.body: Spike on export worker looks feasible because checkpoints already exist from NMA-121 work.

content.text: Spike on export worker looks feasible because checkpoints already exist from NMA-121 work.
Long export and reindex jobs are sometimes intentionally paused for maintenance windows, but today pause cancels the lease and the job restarts from scratch or is marked failed.

Workers should support pause and resume control messages that freeze progress, renew a paused lease with a longer TTL, and on resume continue from the last checkpoint without reprocessing completed partitions.
Acceptance: pause is idempotent; resume fails clearly if the checkpoint is missing; paused jobs do not count toward concurrency slots; ops endpoint shows paused state and lease expiry.
